toolsPreview.name: classify
toolsPreview.description: Classify a product description into candidate HS/HTS10 tariff codes. Deterministic BM25 retrieval over the USITC HTS schedule with heading-agreement boosting, returning the full parent-chain description, general duty rate, and a score-gap confidence per candidate. Not a customs ruling — always includes a disclaimer to verify with a licensed broker.
